description: Golden SQL pairs for product catalog, pricing, brands, categories, and variant attributes.

sql_pairs.question: What are the top 5 best-selling products by total sales revenue?
sql_pairs.sql: SELECT p.id, p.name AS product_name, b.name AS brand_name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS units_sold, SUM(oi.total_price) AS total_revenue FROM products p JOIN brands b ON p.brand_id = b.id JOIN order_items oi ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status IN ('delivered', 'shipped') GROUP BY p.id, p.name, b.name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 5;

sql_pairs.question: Which products have sold the highest number of units?
sql_pairs.sql: SELECT p.id, p.name AS product_name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_units_sold, SUM(oi.total_price) AS total_sales FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status IN ('delivered', 'shipped') GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY total_units_sold DESC LIMIT 10;

sql_pairs.question: Show the number of products and average price in each parent category.
sql_pairs.sql: SELECT c.id, c.name AS category_name, COUNT(p.id) AS product_count, ROUND(AVG(p.base_price), 2) AS avg_base_price FROM categories c JOIN products p ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE c.parent_id IS NULL GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY product_count DESC;

sql_pairs.question: List all active brands with their product count and average product price.
sql_pairs.sql: SELECT b.id, b.name AS brand_name, COUNT(p.id) AS total_products, ROUND(AVG(p.base_price), 2) AS avg_price FROM brands b LEFT JOIN products p ON b.id = p.brand_id WHERE b.is_active = 1 GROUP BY b.id, b.name ORDER BY total_products DESC LIMIT 15;

sql_pairs.question: Find the top 5 most expensive product variants with their SKU and product title.
sql_pairs.sql: SELECT pv.id, p.name AS product_name, pv.title AS variant_title, pv.sku, pv.price, pv.compare_at_price FROM product_variants pv JOIN products p ON pv.product_id = p.id WHERE pv.is_active = 1 ORDER BY pv.price DESC LIMIT 5;

sql_pairs.question: Show all product variants available in 'Matte Black' color.
sql_pairs.sql: SELECT pv.id, p.name AS product_name, pv.title, pv.sku, pv.price FROM product_variants pv JOIN products p ON pv.product_id = p.id WHERE pv.option_color = 'Matte Black' AND pv.is_active = 1 ORDER BY pv.price ASC LIMIT 20;

sql_pairs.question: Which products are marked as featured and have a rating average of 4.5 or higher?
sql_pairs.sql: SELECT id, name, sku_prefix, base_price, rating_average, rating_count FROM products WHERE is_featured = 1 AND rating_average >= 4.50 ORDER BY rating_average DESC;

sql_pairs.question: Find products priced higher than the average base price of all products.
sql_pairs.sql: SELECT id, name, base_price FROM products WHERE base_price > (SELECT AVG(base_price) FROM products) ORDER BY base_price DESC LIMIT 10;

sql_pairs.question: List brands that have more than 3 active products in catalog.
sql_pairs.sql: SELECT b.id, b.name AS brand_name, COUNT(p.id) AS product_count FROM brands b JOIN products p ON b.id = p.brand_id GROUP BY b.id, b.name HAVING COUNT(p.id) > 3 ORDER BY product_count DESC;
